list_datasets: list all available dataset names registered in the dataset catalog
check_dataset_exists: check if a named dataset like coco_2014_train exists in the catalog
get_image_directory: get the image directory path for a dataset such as dense_coco_2014_train
get_annotation_file: get the annotation file path for a dataset like keypoints_coco_2014_val
get_dataset_devkit_dir: get the devkit directory path for a VOC dataset like voc_2007_train
